reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is two capsules every day. Even if the sachet is easy to carry, I would still be choking down capsules.
objection: Two capsules a day is a dealbreaker for me. And I have no idea if I would actually feel a difference from magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or powder drink version, or capsules small enough that I could swallow them without a fight.
